list.vod_name: British Columbia North Shore Daydream : Dennis P. Dineen
list.vod_content: It's a busy little stretch of pavement along the old north shore.
Canadiana fun ... A stroke of good fortune to behold the morning sun as Swift Current faded in the rear view mirror ...
Cruise control into Swift Current, Living Sky casino, then a nice peaceful walk around the cemetery under the smiling prairie sun.
Closing in on Swift Current from the east. Anticipation of a peaceful walk through the cemetery.
Love those long beautiful trains in the distance. Don't love unloading boxcars by hand.
There were ghosts of old seismic crews laying many kilometers of cable & jugs along the highway.
